title: NR Symbol Modulator
text: Modulate data bits to complex NR data symbols, 4 inputs, 2 outputs, {Modulation} sets Modulation type; {Modulation source} sets the source for modulation, {Output data type} and {Word length} sets the output word length. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Modulation source
params.values: Source for modulation type Property (default) | Input port

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type selection Custom (default) | double | single

params.name: Word length
params.values: Output word length 16 (default) | integer in the range [3, 32]
